aboutPage.metaDesc: Learn about MAZE Studio — a branding and design studio based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, crafting bold visual identities since 2019.
aboutPage.heroHeading: We navigate brands through complexity to clarity.
aboutPage.heroSub: MAZE is a branding and design studio based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Since 2019, we've built bold visual identities for startups, enterprises, and cultural institutions across Central Asia and beyond.
aboutPage.story1: MAZE was founded in Tashkent in 2019 with a simple conviction: that Central Asian brands deserve world-class design. At the time, the region's design landscape was largely derivative — copying Western trends without strategic intent.
aboutPage.story2: We built MAZE to be different. From day one, we insisted on strategy before aesthetics, on understanding a business deeply before picking up a pen. This approach won us early trust from Uzbekistan's most ambitious companies.
aboutPage.story3: Today, our work reaches millions of people daily — on product labels, apps, storefronts, and city billboards. We remain a tight-knit studio by choice: small enough to care deeply, experienced enough to deliver at scale.

values.title: Clarity from complexity

values.title: Strategy before aesthetics

values.title: Partnership over projects
values.body: We build long-term relationships. Your brand's evolution is our ongoing commitment.

servicesPage.metaDesc: MAZE Studio offers brand identity, brand strategy, naming, UI/UX design, print & packaging, motion design, and art direction.
servicesPage.heroSub: From brand strategy to motion design — we offer the full creative suite that growing brands need to compete and win.
servicesPage.notSureSub: Tell us about your challenge and we'll recommend the right engagement model.

services.title: Brand Identity
services.tagline: The complete visual language of your brand.
services.body: We create comprehensive brand identity systems — the logo, colour palette, typography, imagery style, and iconography that define how your brand looks and feels across every touchpoint. From the first sketch to the final brand guidelines document, we ensure every element works in harmony.

services.title: Brand Strategy
services.tagline: The thinking that makes design matter.
services.body: Before we design anything, we align on strategy. This means understanding your business objectives, audience insights, competitive landscape, and positioning. The output is a strategic brief that becomes the foundation for all creative work — ensuring every design decision has a reason.

services.title: Naming
services.tagline: The right name opens every door.
services.body: A brand name is your most permanent creative decision. We explore hundreds of concepts rooted in cultural resonance, linguistic clarity across markets, and trademark availability — delivering a name that is historically powerful, strategically sound, and unforgettable.

services.title: UI / UX Design
services.tagline: Digital experiences people love to use.
services.body: We design digital products — websites, mobile apps, and SaaS platforms — that balance aesthetic quality with functional clarity. Our process starts with user research, moves through wireframing and prototyping, and delivers production-ready UI with a comprehensive design system.

services.title: Print & Packaging
services.body: Print remains one of the most powerful brand touchpoints. We design stationery systems, packaging, publications, environmental graphics, and campaign materials with the same rigour we apply to digital work — with deep expertise in print production.

services.title: Motion Design
services.body: We bring brand identities to life through motion — animated logos, brand intro sequences, social media content, UI micro-interactions, and motion guidelines that let your team maintain consistency across video content.

services.title: Art Direction
services.tagline: Creative oversight for a unified brand voice.
services.body: When brands grow, maintaining visual consistency across teams, agencies, and channels becomes the challenge. We provide ongoing art direction — overseeing photography, campaign production, and content creation to keep your brand coherent and compelling.
